_comment: Cached example output from a real run of ai_parser.parse_document() against sample_data/nightmare_invoice.pdf, using claude-3-5-haiku-20241022. Bundled so `ai-data-clean demo` works without an API key. Regenerate with: ai-data-clean clean sample_data/nightmare_invoice.pdf --save-cache

line_items.raw_text: Google Ads mgmt fee - Q1 campaign 1 2,450.00 (retainer, includes 2 rounds of creative revisions)
line_items.description: Google Ads management fee - Q1 campaign retainer (includes 2 rounds of creative revisions)

line_items.notes: Quantity listed as '---' in source; treated as not applicable.
Amount appeared on the line below the description in the source; reconstructed as one item.
Description and amount were split across two lines in the source; reconstructed as one item.

line_items.description: Shipping - trade show banners & swag to Austin TX (2 boxes, FedEx Ground)

line_items.description: Adobe Creative Cloud - team plan (4 licenses)

line_items.raw_text: Consulting - GA4 migration audit (Priya R.) 6 hrs 900.00

issues: Subtotal, tax, and TOTAL DUE summary rows were excluded from line items as document totals, not purchases; subtotal (19,458.81) matches the sum of extracted line totals.

No column headers were reliably aligned in the source PDF (text was reconstructed from layout-preserved extraction, not a real table), so quantity/unit price were inferred from context on several rows.
Vendor header block, remittance terms, and footer boilerplate were ignored as non-line-item content.
